verdict.rationale: Open-protocol access and standards-based export are fair questions for an email client, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows Superhuman offering IMAP, JMAP or SMTP access, or exporting mail in a standard format such as mbox or EML. The pack only describes it as a client layered on Gmail and Outlook, and any openness those providers offer is a host-platform capability that earns no credit. The MCP connector for AI assistants is an adjacent feature, not open mail-protocol access or export.
